case_studies.title: Self-Hosted Omnichannel Stack for Multi-Country Outreach
case_studies.summary: Replaced third-party SaaS with a fully self-hosted omnichannel communication + CRM + analytics + automation ecosystem serving local agents, offshore agents, and management across 20+ countries.

case_studies.title: The Data-Platform Decision: Evaluating 4 Candidates, Forking Twenty, Adding Row-Level Security
case_studies.client: Discover Islam Society (Path to Peace operations)
case_studies.summary: Formal requirements-driven evaluation of NocoDB / Twenty / Teable / Mathesar for a master-individual data platform with row+field-level permissions; ended in a surgical Twenty fork adding a community row-level-security engine, white-labelling and a telemetry gate — deployed as the 'Path to Peace' CRM.

case_studies.title: NMC-first: WhatsApp → Postgres Ingest Pipeline with Tailscale-Only Exposure
case_studies.summary: Production realtime pipeline: WhatsApp group messages ingested via a legitimate linked device into Postgres, reachable only over a Tailscale network, with passive-ingest guardrails, versioned deployments and two-way Google Sheets sync for non-technical staff.

case_studies.title: Cost & Sovereignty Audit: 8,000 BHD Saved, $3k/yr SaaS Eliminated, Zero Extended Downtime in a Platform Crisis
case_studies.summary: Transition from proprietary systems and SaaS subscriptions to a self-hosted open-source stack, plus a big-tech diversification strategy that kept operations running when Facebook blocked management credentials.

case_studies.title: Marketing Data Operations: From Campaign Chaos to Country-Level Dashboards
case_studies.summary: Ran the data side of a 20+ country paid-social operation: campaign data prep, phone/country-code normalization at scale, conversion analysis per campaign, and the migration of reporting off Google Sheets into structured databases and dashboards.

case_studies.title: Realtime Language AI: Translation & Transcription Pipelines Built on a Decade of Multilingual Fieldwork
case_studies.client: personal R&D + Discover Islam Society applications
case_studies.summary: AI translation/transcription tooling (realtime Arabic↔English, long-audio WhisperX pipelines sized to consumer hardware, TTS/ASR experiments, book-translation repair workflows) built by someone who spent 4 years doing this work by hand at a government protection center.
